How old do they need to be for the arcade?
turns.agent_response:
Cyber Quest is open to all ages, so your whole group can jump into the games and attractions together. For any younger children between the ages of 6 weeks and 12 years, Kids Quest is also available and provides a supervised space specifically for them to play.

Pro tip—the arcade uses a high-tech card system for the games, which makes it easy for the kids to track their points and trade them in for prizes at the end of the night. While the kids are occupied with gaming, you might want to look into the Elemis Spa for a relaxing morning reset the next day. Are your kids more into the competitive video games or would they enjoy the physical challenge of the Wombi Rock climbing wall?
